gaps: Regions unconfirmed for entries 1, 9, 13 and the first Devils Podcast Fragment: the checklist gives no region for any entry; regions were taken by matching names against MapMaster.
No source states a reward beyond unlocking an Animus lore entry.

MapMaster also lists 5 Riptides Animus Project unlocks (levels 4, 8, 11, 15, 19), which are not in the 30-item checklist and are not included. MapMaster's Havana 'Vault Data File' (end of southern dock) probably equals entry 1 but is unconfirmed.
notes: Backbone is the gamerguides checklist, which calls them Data Files. MapMaster calls the same collectibles Vault Data Files / Data Files (33 entries: 28 on the map plus 5 Riptides unlocks) and separately mentions Data Fragments, a currency from Anomaly challenges that is not a collectible. Vandal uses different titles and puts 8 of its 30 behind Animus Projects or Rifts; used only to resolve Leaked Image. MapMaster's Devils Marketing Plan is on a Corozal tavern roof, which may match checklist entry 22 or 1.
